name: Keeper Albagorm
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm seeks aid as the Charred Vale burns and the wilds suffer.

sections.title: A Guardian on the Peak
sections.body: Keeper Albagorm guards the night elven refuge at Stonetalon Peak. As a son of Cenarius, he feels the pain of the natural world. South of the peak, the Charred Vale lies scorched by a greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Bloodfury harpies now hold the ruins and prevent new growth. From his sanctuary, Albagorm works to halt the corruption and restore balance to the wounded forest.

faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm is a keeper of the grove and one of Cenarius's demigod offspring. He is stationed at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains and allies with the night elves and Kalimdor's natural guardians.

faq.q: Where can I find Keeper Albagorm?
faq.answer: You can find Keeper Albagorm at Stonetalon Peak, an Alliance-aligned druidic refuge high in the northwestern Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What does Keeper Albagorm want help with?
faq.answer: Albagorm wants help healing the Charred Vale. He sends travelers into the ash-choked basin to cleanse the blighted land and drive out the Bloodfury harpies that prevent natural regrowth.

angles.text: As a druid, you share the Cenarion lineage with Albagorm. His effort to cleanse the Charred Vale touches that bond.
As an Alliance member, you can find shelter and guidance from Albagorm at the night elven refuge of Stonetalon Peak.
